senses.gloss: (Saf. of נָטַר) to guard, esp. to watch jealously; to bear grudge.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 67:8">Gen. R. s. 67</cite> (ref. to <he>ויש̇ט̇ם̇</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 27:41">Gen. XXVII, 41</cite>) <he>סִנְטֵירוֹ ונעשה לו ש̇ונא נוקם̇ ונוט̇ר</he> (better <he>סִינְטְרוֹ</he>; Ar. a.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 115">Yalk. Gen. 115</cite> omit our w.) he watched him grudgingly, and became to him a vindictive and grudge-bearing enemy; v. <cite ref="O01212"><he>סַנְטוּרֵי</he></cite>
